mapper.select: select flow_id, flow_key, flow_name, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from pm_flow_definition where flow_id = #{flowId}
select flow_id, flow_key, flow_name, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from pm_flow_definition where flow_key = #{flowKey}
mapper.insert: insert into pm_flow_definition(flow_key, flow_name, status, remark, create_by, create_time) values(#{flowKey}, #{flowName}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
